LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMandate.label: 四時飛花
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMandate.description: 春城無處不飛花，寒食東風御柳斜。
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMandate.completionEffec: 飛花令【絕】——強化所有三個飛花令技能的效果，附加額外的異常狀態積累
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_DivineFortune.label: 涓流之韻
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_DivineFortune.description: 憋不出來了，總之是一句簡介
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_DivineFortune.completionEffec: 剛柔並濟——護盾受到高額傷害時觸發額外保護，單次護盾受傷最高不會超過20點
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerDance.label: 起舞之韻
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerDance.description: 「五陵年少爭纏頭，一曲紅綃不知數」
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMastery.label: 百花玉音
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMastery.description: 靜心明過方可習得的花之真傳
